newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - CASINO DATA rating cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CASINO DATA rating cut.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Tuesday downgraded the rating for Casino Data Systems to market performer from outperform for the immediate and long term.

-- Analyst Steven Bernard cited the company's announcement this morning indicating it will report a loss of between $2 million and $2.5 million in the fourth quarter and take an additional charge of between $1 million and $3 million.

-- Bernard also revised his earnings estimate for fiscal 1996 to $0.32 per share, just below last year's $0.34. He also said he has very low confidence in management's guidance for 1997 and he is currently reviewing fiscal 1997 estimates for possible downward revisions.
-- Casino Data Systems makes slot machine accouting and player tracking systems for the casino gaming industry.
-- Its stock was down 1-1/4 Tuesday at 7-1/4.
